name: @nexus/desktop
description: Nexus desktop shell: Electron main process, preload host bridge
author: Nexus contributors

scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && rolldown src/preload.ts --file dist/preload.js --format cjs --platform node --external electron
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm build:api && pnpm update:config && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
